methodology: Descriptive, deterministic, post-replay analysis of emitted decisions. No counterfactual or physical outcome is inferred.
data_limitations: Decisions are proposals or mock actions, not proof of physical execution.
Counts do not establish false-positive rates without labeled ground truth.
No measured cost, CO2, water, or labor savings are asserted.
Design recommendations are hypotheses pending equipment and work-order validation.

recommendations.title: Review persistent cold-room escalations
recommendations.observation: 68 heating-comfort approval requests recorded in replay.
recommendations.recommendation: Review room-level recovery windows and escalation timing before changing setpoint or alert thresholds.
recommendations.validation_required: Compare occupied-room temperature trajectories before/after simulated adjustments; verify 20–23 C band and approval latency.

recommendations.title: Evaluate weekend cleaning capacity
recommendations.recommendation: Compare arrival deadlines against verified cleaner/robot reservations and recorded completion; review shift staffing for peak days.
recommendations.validation_required: Measure missed deadlines and staff utilization from roster plus completion events, not proposal counts.

recommendations.title: Track outstanding vendor requests
recommendations.observation: 9 logistics vendor-order or escalation decisions recorded.
recommendations.recommendation: Maintain pending/accepted/fulfilled service state and suppress unnecessary repeat proposals until telemetry or vendor confirmation changes state.
recommendations.validation_required: Join service acknowledgements with later stock/fill readings and calculate confirmed lead times.

recommendations.title: Investigate plant maintainability and sensor redundancy
recommendations.observation: Replay includes ventilation/plant maintenance signals; failure causality is not established.
recommendations.recommendation: Assess accessible service points, differential-pressure sensing and fault telemetry in the next building design.
recommendations.validation_required: Validate against confirmed work orders, inspection results and equipment fault logs before specifying hardware changes.

recommendations.title: Evaluate water-meter observability
recommendations.observation: Replay includes suspected water leaks requiring investigation.
recommendations.recommendation: Study whether room and main meters plus diagnostic telemetry adequately distinguish leaks from meter artifacts.
recommendations.validation_required: Cross-check meter gaps against confirmed repairs and known occupancy; do not infer leak rate or savings from alerts.
